notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other creature.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Great Desert Prospector.
Great Desert Prospector enters the battlefield, creating at least two tapped Powerstone artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Powerstones, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
